desc: The nano command opens a lightweight, beginner-friendly text editor directly inside your terminal window. It allows you to quickly create, view, or modify code and configuration files without launching a separate graphical application.

The rm -f command forcefully and permanently deletes files without asking for confirmation or sending them to the Trash. The **`-f`** (force) flag bypasses read-only warnings and silences error messages if the targeted file does not exist.
